mapper.insert: INSERT INTO data_element_upload_batch (data_type, batch_name, original_file_name, stored_file_path, file_hash, file_size, uploader, upload_time, total_rows, business_record_count, recognized_columns, unrecognized_columns, involved_subtypes, duplicate_of_batch_id, import_policy, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{dataType}, #{batchName}, #{originalFileName}, #{storedFilePath}, #{fileHash}, #{fileSize}, #{uploader}, #{uploadTime}, #{totalRows}, #{businessRecordCount}, #{recognizedColumns}, #{unrecognizedColumns}, #{involvedSubtypes}, #{duplicateOfBatchId}, #{importPolicy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE data_element_upload_batch SET total_rows = #{totalRows}, business_record_count = #{businessRecordCount}, recognized_columns = #{recognizedColumns}, unrecognized_columns = #{unrecognizedColumns}, involved_subtypes = #{involvedSubtypes}, data_type = #{dataType}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM data_element_upload_batch WHERE file_hash = #{fileHash} LIMIT 1
